method: one frame per pack, requested with Foresignal's fixture User-Agent and no Referer or Origin (HEAD, plus a GET where HEAD did not settle it); access is direct when the answer was image/* or an HLS playlist, browser when a non-browser client gets an HTML page or 403, key when the host needs a key

s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com.notes: TfL JamCam stills (bucket jamcams.tfl.gov.uk); image/jpeg, no Access-Control-Allow-Origin

wzmedia.dot.ca.gov.notes: Caltrans HLS; application/vnd.apple.mpegurl with Access-Control-Allow-Origin * (some streams answer 404 when the camera is down)

511on.ca.notes: Ontario 511 stills need no key (the catalog does); image/jpeg, Access-Control-Allow-Origin *

webcams.transport.nsw.gov.au.notes: answers non-browser clients with 200 text/html instead of the frame; loads from a real browser

trafficcam.calgary.ca.notes: City of Calgary stills over https; image/jpeg

cctv.austinmobility.io.notes: Austin stills; image/jpeg for TURNED_ON cameras (403 application/xml for planned ones)

tarktee.transpordiamet.ee.notes: Transpordiamet stills; image/jpeg; the file name changes with every image

webcam.warendorf.de.notes: unverified: the host did not answer at the probe; http only (frameInsecure)

www.kreis-warendorf.de.notes: unverified: allowed by the bundled pack, no camera of the pack uses it at present
